title: Profiles
subtitle: A profile decides what each dial shows. When several profiles apply, the one with the highest priority wins.

state.manual: Forced manually: “{{name}}” stays active until you go back to automatic.
state.none: Automatic mode: no profile is active.

help.always: Always eligible: used whenever no higher-priority profile applies. Ideal for your everyday setup (the default profile).
help.auto: Becomes active while its conditions hold. If several profiles match, the one with the highest priority wins.
help.manual: Never activates by itself. Choose it from the header menu, the tray icon or the API.

card.onlyOne: At least one profile is required
card.shadowed: It never activates on its own: “{{name}}” is always active and has a higher priority.

delete.title: Delete this profile?
delete.message: “{{name}}” and the dial settings it contains will be removed. You can still discard the change before saving.
delete.warnDefault: This is the default profile. Dials that other profiles leave unassigned will stay idle until you mark another profile as “Always”.

summary.always: Always eligible. Used when no higher-priority profile applies.
summary.manual: Used only when you choose it (header menu, tray icon or API).
summary.noConditions: No conditions yet: it will never activate on its own.

errors.activate: Could not change the active profile

editor.notFoundHelp: It may have been deleted, or it was created but not saved before the page was reloaded.
editor.name: Name
editor.priorityHelp: Higher number wins. You can also reorder from the list.
editor.enabledHelp: Disabled profiles are ignored, even when chosen manually.

conditionsIgnored.always: An “Always” profile has no conditions: it is used whenever no higher-priority profile applies.
conditionsIgnored.manual: A manual profile ignores conditions: it is used only when you choose it.

editor.dialsHelp: What each dial shows while this profile is active.
editor.inherit: Use the default profile for the other dials
editor.inheritHelp: Dials that this profile does not configure show what “{{name}}” shows. Turn it off to let them go idle.

conditions.empty: No conditions yet. Add one to let this profile activate automatically.

matchHelp.all: Every condition must match at the same time.

processRunning.label: Program running
processRunning.help: A program is running in the background or foreground.
processRunning.description: Executable names without the path, such as eldenring.exe. Use * as a wildcard (steam*).

foregroundApp.label: Program in foreground
foregroundApp.help: A program owns the window you are working in.
foregroundApp.description: Executable names without the path. Matches only while the program’s window has the focus.

sensor.label: Sensor value
sensor.help: A sensor goes above or below a value.

conditions.programsPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
conditions.detectHelp: Click, then switch to the program you want within 5 seconds. While you look at this page the foreground app is your browser.
conditions.noForeground: Foreground detection needs the VU Studio tray app (Windows).

schedule.same: Start and end are the same, so this condition never matches.
schedule.wraps: The period runs past midnight into the next day.

dials.none: Not assigned: the dial stays idle.
dials.noneInherit: Not assigned here or in the default profile: the dial stays idle.
dials.empty: No dials known yet. Connect the hub or turn on the simulator in Settings.
